headline: Top-line growth drives a sharp year-over-year profit rebound
summary_short: Revenue rose 11.8% year over year to $939.9M, with net income up 48.3% y/y to $98.9M and diluted EPS of $0.42, though results cooled sequentially from a stronger fiscal Q4.
summary_long: Revenue increased 11.8% year over year to $939.9M but slipped 3.1% sequentially from $969.8M. Gross margin expanded to 68.8% from 66.7% a year ago, though it eased from 71.9% in the prior quarter. Diluted EPS of $0.42 was up 55.6% y/y but down 35.4% q/q from $0.65. Cash fell to $234.1M from $290.0M a year earlier, while long-term debt held near flat at $1,402.5M.
